name: node-mmo-game
description: Multiplayer browser game built with Node.js, Socket.IO and PixiJS
author: Tomasz Piecha

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const path of ['dist', 'dist-test']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test:compile: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run test:compile && npm run test:run
